layoutProfile.name: wide-desktop-reference
layoutProfile.description: Approximate wide-window Word 2021 ribbon layout for visual reconstruction/quiz rendering.

coordinateSystem.rowMeaning: Small controls normally occupy one of three vertical rows. Large controls span all three rows.
coordinateSystem.columnMeaning: Logical position within each group, not pixel coordinates.

layoutProfile.importantNote: This is a renderer-oriented model, not an official Microsoft export. Word's real ribbon is responsive and may rearrange/collapse controls based on window width and build.
